pages.title: Sakura Haruno with Long Hair in Her Classic Naruto Outfit Outside the Ninja Academy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno outside the Ninja Academy, smiling in her classic outfit with long hair and a Leaf Village headband. The coloring sheet includes circular dress emblems, a thigh pouch, and open-toed sandals. The academy entrance, large Leaf symbol, and nearby bushes add architectural and foliage details around her full-length pose.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno in Her Naruto Shippuden Outfit at the Hidden Leaf Village Gates Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno stands at the Hidden Leaf Village gates in this printable coloring page, wearing her Shippuden outfit and raising one gloved fist. Her short hair, forehead protector, split skirt, and thigh pouch define the character. Leaf emblems on the open gates, rounded rooftops, and distant mountains fill the village setting behind her.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Wearing Her Fourth Great Ninja War Flak Jacket and Allied Shinobi Forehead Protector Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sakura Haruno wearing her Fourth Great Ninja War flak jacket and Allied Shinobi forehead protector on rocky ground. Her vest has paired chest pockets and shoulder panels, while a strapped pouch sits against her trousers. Mountains, scattered boulders, and cloud outlines surround her full-length figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno in Her the Last Movie Outfit on the Moon Mission Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno on the moon mission in her outfit from The Last, with a forehead diamond and clenched fist. Her sleeveless tunic has an offset fastening, wide waistbands, and split skirt panels. A large crescent and scattered rocks frame the figure, adding curved and angular sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno in Her Adult Boruto Outfit at the Uchiha Family Home Coloring Page
pages.description: Adult Sakura Haruno stands outside the Uchiha family home in this printable coloring page, wearing her Boruto outfit with a sleeveless tunic and cropped trousers. She lifts one hand beside her short hair, with the diamond mark visible on her forehead. A fan emblem decorates the wooden entrance beneath a tiled roof, surrounded by bushes and stone paving.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno as a Chibi Ninja Holding a Kunai Beside a Training Target Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Sakura Haruno holds a kunai beside a wooden training target in this printable coloring page, smiling with a raised fist and wide stance. Her oversized head, short hair, Leaf forehead protector, and circular skirt emblem give the figure clear character details. Concentric target rings and patches of grass add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Smiling with Her Angry Inner Sakura Spirit Behind Her Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno smiles with her hands together in this printable coloring page, while her angry Inner Sakura spirit raises both fists above her. Jagged outlines and puff shapes surround the shouting spirit, contrasting with Sakura's relaxed pose. Long hair and Leaf headbands connect the two figures, with rooftop railings and clustered village buildings below.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Receiving a Hair Ribbon From Ino Yamanaka at the Ninja Academy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno receiving a hair ribbon from Ino Yamanaka outside the Ninja Academy, with both girls holding its ends. Ino wears a high ponytail and a scarf, while Sakura has a Leaf headband and circular dress emblem. The long ribbon tails, wooden doorway, and large academy symbol add separate details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Choosing Daffodils with Ino Yamanaka at the Yamanaka Flower Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno chooses daffodils with Ino Yamanaka at the Yamanaka Flower Shop in this printable coloring page, holding one blossom above the counter. Ino stands behind the counter wearing a tied apron, beside a vase of flowers. Petals and narrow leaves form small enclosed sections, while wooden wall panels and the counter provide broader areas.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Facing Ino Yamanaka in the Chunin Exam Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno facing Ino Yamanaka in the Chunin Exam arena, with both ninjas holding bent-knee fighting stances. Sakura raises her fists, while Ino extends an open palm and wears mesh sleeves and leg coverings. Their outfit panels and the broad arena floor leave larger spaces among the coloring sheet's smaller clothing details.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Answering Questions During the Chunin Exam Written Test Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno answers questions during the Chunin Exam written test in this printable coloring page, seated at a desk with a pencil in hand. Her free hand rests beside the exam paper, and a Leaf forehead protector sits above her short hair. Rows of empty desks and chairs establish the classroom setting around the close-up figure.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Cutting Her Hair with a Kunai in the Forest of Death Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno cutting her hair with a kunai in the Forest of Death, holding a lock beside the blade. Her wide stance, serious expression, Leaf headband, and thigh pouch remain clearly outlined. Tall tree trunks, exposed roots, bushes, and grass create a layered forest setting around the central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Protecting Unconscious Naruto and Sasuke in the Forest of Death Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno protects unconscious Naruto and Sasuke beneath a huge tree in this printable coloring page, standing between them with one open palm raised. Their closed eyes, forehead protectors, and bandaged legs distinguish the resting teammates. Spreading roots and scattered grass fill the forest floor.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Bringing a Flower to Rock Lee at the Hidden Leaf Hospital Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno bringing a flower to Rock Lee at the Hidden Leaf hospital, where he sits smiling on his bed. Bandages wrap his hands and forearms as he reaches toward the daffodil. Bed rails, a folded blanket, and a bedside cabinet complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Practicing Chakra Control By Climbing a Tree in the Land of Waves Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno practices chakra control by climbing a tree in the Land of Waves in this printable coloring page, pressing her sandals against the trunk. Her bent knee and outstretched hands emphasize the upward pose. Long bark lines, leafy branches, and her strapped thigh pouch supply smaller outlined details.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Guarding Tazuna on the Land of Waves Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno guarding Tazuna on the Land of Waves bridge, holding both palms outward in a wide protective stance. Tazuna stands behind her wearing round glasses and carrying tools at his waist. Repeating bridge planks and railings create clear sections around the two figures.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Taking Kakashi Hatake's First Bell Test at the Training Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno takes Kakashi Hatake's first bell test at the training ground in this printable coloring page, reaching toward the bells in his hand. Kakashi wears his mask and pocketed vest while Sakura holds a low stance. Tree trunks and bushes frame the pair on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Posing with Naruto Sasuke and Kakashi for the Original Team 7 Photograph Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno posing with Naruto, Sasuke, and Kakashi for the original Team 7 photograph, clustered together in a wooded clearing. Naruto makes a peace sign as Kakashi rests his hands above the students. Sakura's smile, Sasuke's high collar, and their Leaf headbands distinguish the group.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Greeting Naruto After His Return to the Hidden Leaf Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno greets Naruto after his return to the Hidden Leaf Village in this printable coloring page, waving beneath the large emblem above the gates. Naruto carries a buckled shoulder bag beside her. Open wooden doors, rounded village buildings, and distant carved faces add details behind their full-length figures.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno and Naruto Challenging Kakashi Hatake in the Second Bell Test Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno and Naruto challenging Kakashi Hatake in the second bell test, with Kakashi holding two bells above them. Sakura reaches forward while Naruto crouches behind her. The three staggered figures, patterned equipment, bushes, and distant mountain outline create a layered training scene.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Asking Tsunade to Accept Her as a Medical Ninja Apprentice Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno asks Tsunade to accept her as a medical ninja apprentice in this printable coloring page, bowing beside the desk in Tsunade's office. Tsunade stands with one hand on her hip and a diamond mark on her forehead. Stacked books, a chair, and the village view complete the setting.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Practicing Medical Ninjutsu By Healing a Fish Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno practicing medical ninjutsu by healing a fish, kneeling with both hands hovering above a shallow wooden tray. Outlined chakra rings surround her palms, and individual scales mark the fish. A bucket, rocks, trees, and distant village buildings provide additional coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Breaking a Training Boulder with a Chakra-enhanced Punch Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno breaks a training boulder with a chakra-enhanced punch in this printable coloring page, extending one gloved fist into a web of cracks. Angular rock fragments scatter around her hand while her other fist remains drawn back. Rope-wrapped training posts and layered cliffs surround the wide fighting stance.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Treating Kankuro at the Hidden Sand Hospital Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno treating Kankuro at the Hidden Sand hospital, standing beside his bed with both hands above his chest. Kankuro rests beneath a blanket with bandaged forearms and patterned facial markings. A wheeled medical trolley, bed rails, and buildings outside the window establish the hospital scene.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Preparing an Antidote for Sasori's Poison Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno prepares an antidote for Sasori's poison in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside a wooden table and examining a small stoppered bottle. A mortar, pestle, and two additional bottles sit in front of her. Rocky cliffs and scattered stones surround the outdoor preparation scene.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno and Chiyo Facing Sasori and His Puppet Army Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno and Chiyo facing Sasori and his puppet army, with the two women holding defensive poses in the foreground. Chiyo spreads her fingers beneath trailing puppet strings while Sakura raises her fists. Jointed puppet limbs and canyon walls add detailed outlines behind them.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Smashing Sasori's Hiruko Puppet with Her Fist Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno smashes Sasori's Hiruko puppet with her fist in this printable coloring page, punching through its cracked shell as fragments fly outward. The large puppet has jointed fingers, protruding spikes, and a segmented tail arching overhead. Boulders and distant cliffs anchor the action on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Dodging the Third Kazekage Puppet's Iron Sand Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno dodging the Third Kazekage puppet's Iron Sand attack, leaning away from a large angular shape sweeping behind her. Curving motion lines and small debris emphasize the attack. The looming puppet, open hands, and rocky landscape add contrasting shapes around her low stance.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Standing Beside Gaara After His Rescue From the Akatsuki Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno stands beside Gaara after his rescue from the Akatsuki in this printable coloring page, resting one hand against his upper arm. Gaara folds his arms and carries a large strapped gourd. Their layered clothing, open-toed sandals, canyon ledges, and distant buildings create distinct areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Healing Naruto After the Battle at Tenchi Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno healing Naruto after the battle at Tenchi Bridge, kneeling beside him with her hands above his chest. Naruto lies on the bridge with closed eyes and his head against a rolled pack. Parallel wooden planks, railings, and steep wooded cliffs frame the scene.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Meeting Sasuke Again in Orochimaru's Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno meets Sasuke again in Orochimaru's hideout in this printable coloring page, facing him inside a narrow corridor with cracked walls and an archway. Sakura holds one fist against her chest. Sasuke's raised collar, thick rope belt, and sheathed sword supply the scene's most prominent clothing and equipment details.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Treating Hinata Hyuga After Pain's Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sakura Haruno treating Hinata Hyuga after Pain's attack, holding her hands above Hinata as she rests on a folding stretcher. Broken walls and rubble surround the two figures. Hinata's long hair, folded hands, and blanket contrast with the smaller outlines of the damaged village.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Helping Katsuyu Care for Survivors in the Ruined Hidden Leaf Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno helps Katsuyu care for survivors in the ruined Hidden Leaf Village in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside the large slug and a seated woman. Katsuyu's antennae and wavy markings form curved sections. Cracked walls, exposed beams, and scattered masonry give the coloring sheet a detailed setting.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Embracing Naruto After He Returns as the Hidden Leaf Village Hero Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno embracing Naruto after he returns as the Hidden Leaf Village hero, with both characters smiling and closing their eyes. Sakura lifts one foot as Naruto holds her around the waist. The rooftop railing, village towers, and carved mountain faces surround their central pose.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Healing a Shinobi Inside an Allied Medical Camp Tent Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno heals a shinobi inside an Allied medical camp tent in this printable coloring page, standing beside a folding cot in her pocketed vest. The patient wears bandages and rests beneath a blanket. Bottles, a stool, tent poles, and long fabric folds establish the temporary treatment area.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Carrying a Medical Bag Beneath a Cherry Blossom Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno carrying a medical bag beneath a cherry blossom tree, walking along a path with petals drifting around her. The rectangular bag has a flap and fastening beside her leg. Large outlined flowers arch above, while a fence and distant village roofs recede behind her.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Using the Hundred Healings Technique with Branching Seal Markings Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno using the Hundred Healings Technique, with branching seal markings spreading across her face, shoulders, and raised arms. Both fists are clenched beside her sleeveless tunic. Sweeping curved lines and drifting leaves circle the figure above a cracked, rocky landscape.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Summoning Katsuyu During the Fourth Great Ninja War Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno summons Katsuyu during the Fourth Great Ninja War in this printable coloring page, kneeling with one palm pressed against the cracked ground. The enormous slug rises behind her with long antennae and wavy body markings. Rounded smoke curls contrast with angular rocks across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Riding Katsuyu Beside Naruto on Gamakichi and Sasuke on Aoda Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno riding Katsuyu beside Naruto on Gamakichi and Sasuke on Aoda, arranging the three teammates on their large summons. Katsuyu's rounded body fills the foreground, while the toad and coiled snake rise behind. Spots, scales, antennae, and rocky ground add varied outlined sections.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Standing Back to Back with Naruto and Sasuke on the War Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno stands back to back with Naruto and Sasuke on the war battlefield in this printable coloring page, raising her fists between her teammates. Naruto extends an open palm while Sasuke holds his sword downward. Rope knots, equipment pouches, cloud outlines, and scattered rocks complete the three-character scene.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Sharing Chakra with Obito to Open a Portal and Rescue Sasuke Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno sharing chakra with Obito to open a portal and rescue Sasuke, resting her hands on Obito's shoulders. Obito kneels with one hand extended beside the swirling opening. Sasuke steps through the oval portal, his rope belt and sword visible against the rocky background.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Facing Shin Uchiha in His Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno faces Shin Uchiha in his hideout in this printable coloring page, holding both fists ready inside a cavern with cracked walls and ledges. Shin extends an arm covered in eye markings beneath his patterned cloak. Large cave surfaces surround the smaller clothing, facial, and equipment details.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Punching Kaguya During Team 7's Final Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno punching Kaguya during Team 7's final attack, descending above Kaguya while Naruto and Sasuke stand farther behind. Kaguya's long hair spreads over her flowing, patterned robes. Horns, circular motifs, floating fragments, and jagged peaks create numerous outlined details around the central strike.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Healing Naruto and Sasuke Beside the Valley of the End Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno heals Naruto and Sasuke beside the Valley of the End waterfall in this printable coloring page, kneeling between her two seated teammates. Her hands reach toward Naruto's bandaged arm as Sasuke rests nearby. The waterfall, river, cliff faces, and two towering statues establish the detailed background.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Receiving Sasuke's Forehead Poke at the Hidden Leaf Village Gates Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno receiving Sasuke's forehead poke at the Hidden Leaf Village gates, standing opposite him beneath the large Leaf emblem. Sasuke reaches toward her with two fingers while his sword hangs behind his rope belt. Open gate panels and clustered rooftops frame the pair.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Wearing a Kimono at Naruto and Hinata's Wedding Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno wears a kimono at Naruto and Hinata's wedding in this printable coloring page, smiling with closed eyes and holding a small matching handbag. Flower motifs cover her long sleeves and skirt, with blossoms pinned beside her hair. The wedding couple, bouquet, and decorated canopy appear behind her.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Hugging Sarada Uchiha After Their Family Rescue Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sakura Haruno hugging Sarada Uchiha after their family rescue, kneeling as Sarada wraps her arms around her mother's neck. Sarada wears rectangular glasses and a sleeveless outfit, and both figures smile with closed eyes. A railing, village buildings, and drifting leaves surround the embrace.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Training Sarada Uchiha in Chakra-enhanced Strength Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno trains Sarada Uchiha in chakra-enhanced strength in this printable coloring page, striking a boulder while Sarada watches with both fists raised. Cracks and flying fragments radiate from Sakura's extended hand. Sarada's glasses, Leaf headband, and equipment pouch add small details beside the larger rocky forms.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Teaching Sarada Uchiha Medical Ninjutsu in a Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sakura Haruno teaching Sarada Uchiha medical ninjutsu in a classroom, demonstrating over a fish while Sarada writes in an open book. A shallow tray, stacked books, pencils, and a small container cover the desk. The blackboard and rows of seats complete the lesson setting.

pages.title: Sakura Haruno Posing for an Uchiha Family Photograph with Sasuke and Sarada Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura Haruno poses for an Uchiha family photograph with Sasuke and Sarada in this printable coloring page, standing beside her daughter and her cloaked husband. Sarada wears glasses and clasps her hands in front. The parents' hands on her shoulders, village rooftops, and surrounding trees define the family portrait.

pages.title: Naruto Sakura in Misty Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Naruto and Sakura together in a misty forest setting, smiling beneath their Leaf forehead protectors in a close-up paired portrait. Naruto has cheek markings and a small bandage, while Sakura wears a belted outfit. Tall trunks and leafy canopies frame the broad clothing sections.

pages.title: Naruto Sakura in Abandoned Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sakura stand inside an abandoned temple in this printable coloring page, facing forward beneath broken roof beams and a hanging paper charm. Cobwebs stretch between the columns behind them. A ceremonial gate, scattered boards, cracked flooring, and torn wall sections give the coloring sheet numerous architectural details.

pages.title: Naruto Sakura on Riverbank Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Sakura standing on a riverbank, with Naruto holding a rolled scroll beside his pouch and Sakura smiling nearby. Their forehead protectors, clothing seams, and sandal straps provide small character details. Curving water lines, rocks, grass, and trees frame the full-length pair.

pages.title: Naruto Sakura in Samurai Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sakura pose in a samurai fortress courtyard in this printable coloring page, standing on a wooden walkway before a tall building with layered roofs. Sakura wears a sleeveless top while Naruto has a high-collared jacket. Railings, stone walls, decorative roof ends, and a shaped tree surround them.
